author: Inside Edition
description: Britney Spears avoided jail time from a DUI charge that has been hanging over her. The 44-year-old "Toxic" singer took a plea deal for a lesser charge known as "wet reckless." She was sentenced to a year of probation and one night in jail, credited as time served. The pop star must also see a psychologist weekly and a psychiatrist twice a month. The charges stem from a March 4 incident in Westlake Village, California. Inside Edition's Jim Moret has more.
title: Britney Is Free Again

author: Inside Edition
description: A plane passenger who recently got drenched while sitting in his seat is sharing his story. Kevin Glover was seated on a United Airlines flight from Houston to Chicago. He says an unidentified liquid began to fall on him before the plane took off, and by the end of the flight, he was completely soaked. Video of the unfortunate incident went viral. Now, Glover is sharing his story with Inside Edition's Steven Fabian.
title: 'Drip Drip' Plane Passenger Speaks Out

author: Inside Edition
description: A South African police officer was filmed being airlifted from the Komati River where he secured and removed a euthanized crocodile Saturday. The footage shows the officer during a search-and-rescue operation on the east coast of the country to locate what is believed to be the remains of a missing person. Authorities said that the team found human remains inside the intestines of the crocodile, and said they would conduct DNA tests to confirm the identity of the victim.
title: Human Remains Found In Crocodile After Police Airlift It From River

author: Inside Edition
description: Former New York City Mayor Rudy Guiliani has been hospitalized and is in critical condition in a Florida hospital, according to his spokesperson. "Mayor Giuliani is a fighter who has faced every challenge in his life with unwavering strength, and he's fighting with that same level of strength as we speak. We do ask that you join us in prayer for America's Mayor-Rudy Giuliani,” his spokesperson said in a statement. The 81-year-old reportedly has pneumonia.
title: Former NYC Mayor Rudy Guiliani, 81, Hospitalized In Critical Condition

author: Inside Edition
description: Spirit Airlines is grounded for good. The budget flyer ceased operations abruptly and without providing much help for customers. The company's website simply says, "It is with great disappointment that on May 2, 2026, Spirit Airlines started an orderly wind-down of our operations, effective immediately. To our Guests: all flights have been cancelled, and customer service is no longer available." Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Spirit Airlines Cancels All Flights And Abruptly Ceases Operations

description: April Balascio learned a terrible secret about her father, which led to her making a difficult decision.
title: She Discovered Her Dad Was A Serial Killer #shorts
